The Chinese characters for Dennis

As a transliteration, Dennis is usually written 丹尼斯 (Dān ní sī). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Origin and meaning

From Greek, Dennis carries the meaning “follower of Dionysus”.

About the name Dennis

From the Greek god Dionysus; a steady classic of the mid-20th century.
